en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city along a river, with a metal truss bridge in the foreground, rows of historic multi‑storey buildings on the riverbank, and a steep hill behind them crowned by a fortress complex. A tall church tower with an onion dome and clock stands prominently to the right, and another clock tower is visible on the hillside. Printed caption text appears at the upper left, and commercial signage is visible on riverside buildings.
